review.tagline: Local model runner with CLI and REST API for open-weight LLMs
review.summary: Ollama downloads and runs open models from its library (for example Gemma 4) through a CLI and a REST API on localhost:11434. It uses llama.cpp as its backend and ships official Python and JavaScript client libraries. The `ollama launch` command connects it to tools such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and OpenClaw.
review.audience: Developers and self-hosters who want a local model API behind their apps
strengths: One-line installers for macOS, Windows and Linux, plus an official Docker image
REST API at /api/chat with official Python and JavaScript clients
Large community integration list: chat UIs, editors, RAG tools and SDKs in many languages
Modelfile and model import let you customize or bring your own weights
weaknesses: README gives no RAM, VRAM or GPU requirements per model
Backend is llama.cpp only, per the README's supported backends list
No built-in web chat UI or multi-user accounts mentioned; needs a third-party front-end
README mentions cloud models but does not detail how they work or what they cost
needs: Models: Ollama model library, Gemma 4, Modelfile, model import
